messages:
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: high 5xx rate on /v1/infer gateway (svc: ingress-gateway). Severity: P1. Paging oncall: sanjay.

sanjay: seeing the alert & spikes in Grafana, 5xx up ~4x over last 3m. Alert says spike concentrated on cluster=ingress->model-pool-3.

kevin: jumping in. any recent config rollouts to ingress or route weights?

anya: I pushed an e2e routing tweak ~30m ago to route weight split for model-pool-2/3 (traffic shaping). Not a full rollout but a canary.

maria: curious if retries got enabled at the LB layer too. Retries+low cb thresholds = bad.

kevin: checking envoy metrics: upstream_rq_5xx increased, upstream_rq_timeouts also up. Retries observed in logs: many requests retried 2x before failing.

sanjay: can you paste the offending envoy cluster stats?

kevin: ```
cluster.model-pool-3.upstream_rq_5xx: 420
cluster.model-pool-3.upstream_rq_timeouts: 180
cluster.model-pool-3.upstream_rq_retry: 760
cluster.model-pool-3.circuit_breakers.cx_open: 12
```

anya: oh crap, my canary changed the route weight and the canary policy included an experimental per-route retry of 2 and a priority circuit-breaker with max retries low. I intended it for model-pool-2 only, not pool-3.

maria: that explains cascade. pool-3 backend is slower for longer contexts, retries pile up and CB opens, causing 5xx. We should stop retries and reduce weight to 0 for pool-3 immediately.

sanjay: mitigation plan: 1) set route weight pool-3 -> 0 (drain) 2) disable retries at the ingress virtual host 3) increase circuit-breaker max connections temporarily 4) escalate if still failing. Can someone run the quick patch?

kevin: applying temporary rate/weight override now via ingress-control plane (hotpatch): ```
# ingress override
kubectl -n infra exec ingress-control-0 -- envoyctl routes update \ 
  --virtual-host inference-vhost --route '/v1/infer' --set-weight 'model-pool-3:0,model-pool-2:100'
```

kevin: done. Confirmed route weight changed. Also toggling retries off on that route.```kubectl -n infra exec ingress-control-0 -- envoyctl route set-retries --virtual-host inference-vhost --route '/v1/infer' --retries 0```

anya: rolling back my canary to previous config in config-repo and starting CI to push a proper fix. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingress-config/pulls/482

maria: increasing CB thresholds: ```
kubectl -n infra exec ingress-control-0 -- envoyctl cluster set-cb --cluster model-pool-3 --max-conns 200 --max-pending 50
```

kevin: after weight change and retries off, 5xx rate is dropping in Grafana. upstream_rq_5xx down 70% in the last 2m. latency also improving.

ops-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation in progress. Alert suppressed for 10m while oncall monitors.

sanjay: customer impact: quick check from support - two customers reported elevated errors during the spike (IDs: cust-993, cust-421). Impact window approx 09:07-09:20. We should run request replay for those customers and flag for SE.

anya: creating follow-up bug: mis-scoped canary policy allowed retries to hit pool-3. Will add automated validation to prevent per-route retry assignment without owner approval. Tracking issue: INF-1429.

maria: verifying end-to-end: run small curl test to /v1/infer with long context to exercise pool-3 edge case. kevin, can you run and paste?

kevin: ```
curl -s -X POST https://ingress.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"<long context>...","max_tokens":512}' -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code} T:%{time_total}\n' 
```

kevin: test shows HTTP:200 T:0.82 after changes. Pre-change it was 502/504 in repeated runs.

sanjay: looks like we mitigated. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. Maria, can you take the oncall handoff in 20m? I need to jump to another pager.

maria: yep, I'll take it. Handoff checklist: confirm metrics stable for 15m, ensure retries remain disabled, confirm config PR (#482) is reverted or corrected, notify support & CSMs about impact window and remediation steps.

anya: I'm going to patch the canary logic and add unit tests for mapping retry policies to cluster selectors. Will target a hotfix later today.

kevin: adding a small note to runbook: if retries are enabled on ingress, ensure backend latency profile is verified for target pools or limit retries per-cluster. I'll create a follow-up PR to runbook: RUN-302.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: green for 10m after mitigation, suppression cleared. Please file postmortem if impact >= two customers.

sanjay: filing postmortem and initial impact summary. I'll include timeline, root cause (mis-scoped canary that added retries + weight shift to model-pool-3 causing retry amplification), mitigations, and follow-ups (INF-1429, RUN-302). Drafting now.

maria: handover complete. taking over monitoring. If anything resurfaces ping @maria directly. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:
